kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نقتنع (form VIII)
# نَقْتَنِعُ (naqtaniʕu) /naq.ta.ni.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَنَعَ (iqtanaʕa)
# نَقْتَنِعَ (naqtaniʕa) /naq.ta.ni.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَنَعَ (iqtanaʕa)
# نَقْتَنِعْ (naqtaniʕ) /naq.ta.niʕ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِقْتَنَعَ (iqtanaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
